title: La Talavera de Cholula, MAJESTIC STORIES
comment: talavera-cholula (MAJESTIC): taller de talavera en San Pedro Cholula, Puebla. Caras comunes, no famosas; los cuatro se distinguen a simple vista.

chars.EZEQUIEL_OSORIO: Mexican man from Puebla, owner of a talavera workshop, 64 years old, heavy-set, light-brown skin, grey slicked-back hair, a thick grey mustache, a wine-red shirt under a brown suede vest, a silver belt buckle, a silver ring, dark trousers, his hands empty.
chars.RUBEN_TAPIA: Mexican man from Puebla, 40 years old, strong, brown skin, curly black hair, a short beard, a denim button-up shirt with rolled sleeves over a white t-shirt, khaki trousers, clay dust on his forearms, his hands empty.
chars.LEONOR_OSORIO: Mexican woman from Puebla, 60 years old, light-brown skin, grey hair tied in a bun, gold earrings, a mustard-yellow shawl with fringes over a navy-blue dress, her hands empty.
chars.FAUSTO_CUELLAR: Mexican businessman, 55 years old, tall and thin, light skin, dyed black hair, a black goatee, aviator sunglasses, a black leather jacket over a grey shirt, a gold chain, black trousers, black boots, holding a leather folder.

locs.LOC_TALLERTALAVERA: Traditional talavera pottery workshop in San Pedro Cholula, Puebla, in the golden afternoon: an arched patio with shelves full of blue-and-white glazed talavera plates and vases, a wood-fired kiln, a potter's wheel, a rustic wooden table, the great pyramid with a yellow church on top far in the background, warm light, no readable text, no signs, no logos, no people.
